name: Shapeshifting (Alteri)
description: Alteri can mimic the general physical characteristics of any race. An Alteri maintains a list of Shifts they can perform (up to 2 times Racial level). Additional Shifts are learned using 'list' rules and require extended contact with a member of that race.

name: Waveborne (Aquios)
description: <html><center>Aquata can survive under water indefinitely and move twice their move speed when swimming.</center></html>

name: Skittish (Ardian)
description: Ardians can move 5ft at the end of any turn during which they took damage.

name: Avarice (Azuri)
description: Azuri choose a Pursuit character attribute at character creation and a minimum of one skill for that attribute. Azuri add their racial level as a bonus to skills matching their pursuit. Additionally, they make take 20 when using these skills in any situation where a character could take 10.

name: Green Giant (Boxlor)
description: Boxlor can regenerate a lost limb or from another significant injury by spending a cumulative 24 hours in long rest. A Boxlor is considered to be large size and receives all bonuses and penalties thereof.

name: Path to Progress (Cetryu)
description: Cetryu never suffer penalties to KNOW or MECH checks and can take 10 on such checks when under pressure. Cetryu use KNOW in place of INT for any skill where KNOW seems relevant.

name: Catalytic Converter (Construct)
description: A construct may install, assimilate, or otherwise use catalysts. Acclimation to a new catalyst will be treated as a 'list' addition and be subject to the same time requirements. Removing a catalyst requires one hour.

name: Honorbound (Deckan)
description: Deckans receive a bonus to Attack and Damage while in 'honorable' standing. If a Deckan is reduced to an honorless state, these bonuses become penalties and the Deckan suffers an additional -10 WILL until their honor is restored.

name: Jousting Charge (En)
description:
Receive a bonus to ATK equal to 1/2x racial rank during a charge attack.
Receive a bonus to BDMG and TDMG equal to racial rank during a charge attack.
Your minimum charge range is 10ft and your maximum charge range is increased by 5ft x racial rank.

name: Evan
description: Evans have a distinct Hero or Villain alignment. Evans gain a Hero or Villain index equal to their race level. An Evan can spend an index point to grant all allies a bonus to current Init equal to their race level.

name: Witchcraft (Felsh)
description: Felsh receive Aura Ritual equal to their race level. Felsh also increase their Max Ranks by 0.5% per race level.

name: Felshify (Felsh Cat)
description: Felsh Cats can turn into their humanoid forms or revert to their cat forms once per turn as a free action.

name: Mastercraft (Forven)
description: Forven add their entire INT mod to Crafting rolls. When crafting, Forven can spend additional time to improve their crafting outcome. Each additional hour increases their result by 2 and they may spend additional time until the result is Masterwork. Forven also generate 50% additional crafting revenue.

name: Versatility (Gaian)
description: Gaians gain an additional skill and an additional feature at level 1.

name: Angelic Host (Irdon)
description: Irdon host an angelic spirit controlled by the narrator. An Irdon's spirit generates a resource referred to as their Angel Index. An Irdon may consume a point from their index to add an additional target to a non-AoE ability. Doing so will double the cost of that ability. The Angel index will be restored following a long rest.

name: Balance in All Things (Kenti)
description: Kenti who are in Balance receive a +1 bonus to all attributes aside from their primary attribute. A Kenti is in balance if all of their attributes aside from their primary attribute are within 1.5 of the average of those attributes.

name: Tails of the Fox (Kitsune)
description: Kitsune can invoke an ancestral spirit as a free action once per day. The effects of this invocation remain with the Kitsune until they invoke a different spirit. Kitsune can invoke any of the tailed spirits from one up to their racial level.

name: Darklight (Loben)
description: Loben have exceptional senses of sight, hearing, and smell. Loben are also capable of cutting off an overwhelmed sense before they are disoriented. If they are able to utilize even one of these senses, Loben receive no penalties for being blinded, deafened, or odorized.

name: Windsense (Loritho)
description: Loritho get bonus range. Loritho get bonuses to navigation when outside. Once per day, a Loritho can shift their fortunes, rerolling a single die.

name: Imperial Devotion (Meridian)
description: Meridians increase the durations of their debuff and support techniques by one regardless of duration type.

name: Stout Sailor (Nohmen)
description: Nohmen receive the Balance skill at level 1 and automatically succeed at mundane balance checks. Nohmen are considered small creatures, gaining all bonuses and penalties of such.

name: Bloodplague (Nosfer)
description: Nosfer receive a +2 bonus per racial level against all disease and poison effects and are immune to mundane disease and poison. Whenever a Nosfer applies a disease effect to an enemy, apply 'Bloodplague' to that enemy as well, increasing the damage they take from all attacks by the Nosfer's Racial level until End of Round.

name: Beware of Dog (Oon)
description: Oons receive a bonus to grapple actions equal to their racial level. Oons possess a bite attack that can be used as a free action in any state of grapple.

name: Mistwalker (Poruuk)
description: Poruuk can hide in plain sight and increase the DC to track groups they are a part of by an amount equal to their racial level.

name: Formicidae (Quez - Ant)
description: Quez of the Formicidae Family receive +0.5 CON per Racial Level. These Quez have double the standard lifting capacity. Formicidae never become exhausted from travel.

name: Draconic Heritage (Raigon)
description: Raigon can activate their dragonshape as an aura action. Raigon can maintain their dragonshape for a number of rounds each day equal to racial level. In dragonshape, Raigon gain fly speed equal to their move speed and Armor equal to racial level. They can use a breath attack once per day, increased to twice at racial level 6.

name: March of the Dead (Reven)
description: Reven are not immediately rendered unconscious when reduced below 0 HP. Reven make a FORT save (DC equal to their negative HP) at the start of their turn. If they succeed, they remain conscious. Additionally, any creature damaged by the Reven which dies briefly enters the Reven's service. This creature may not attack, but occupies its tile.

name: Reign of Terror (Skren)
description: Skren receive the Intimidate skill at level 1. At the start of a Skren's combat turn, make an Intimidate check and multiply the result by your racial level. Any creature with less HP than this value must make a WILL save (DC your original intimidate check). A creature that fails this save has their morale broken.

name: Photosynthesis (Theran)
description: Therans require 1/2 rations and 1/2 sleep time. Increase INIT by 1/2 racial level during daylight. Increase RESISTALL by twice racial level outside daylight.

name: Sacred Folklore (Vindis)
description: Vindis have the rank cost and xp requirement for spirit affinity techniques reduced by 25%. Vindis can summon a companion spirit.

name: Demonic Host (Vyrek)
description: Vyrek host a demonic spirit controlled by the narrator. A Vyrek's spirit generates a resource referred to as their Demon Index. A Vyrek may consume a point from their index to increase the damage of a non-AoE ability by 50%. Doing so will double the cost of that ability. This effect may be activated after the hit has been confirmed. The Demon index will be restored following a long rest.

name: Faekind (Xid)
description: Xid are tiny creatures and are subject to all bonuses and penalties that entails. Xid do not occupy the tile they are in and must enter an enemy's tile to make a melee attack. Xid have the natural ability to fly and have natural flight speed equal to 15ft + 2.5ft per racial level.

name: Hybridize (Zyan)
description: Zyans can assume or revert their hybrid form as a free action once per turn. The bonuses of this form depend on the Xyan's culture.

name: Hardy
description: Increases your base HP by 10% and your HP multiplier by 2%.

name: Durable
description: Increases your base HP by 20% and your HP multiplier by 3%.

name: Spiritual
description: Increases your base aura by 10% and your aura multiplier by 2%.

name: Attuned
description: Increases your base aura by 20% and your aura multiplier by 3%.

name: Combat Medic
description: Your heals do not provoke an attack of opportunity.

name: Martial Feature I
description: Gain a Martial type Feature of your choice.

name: War Charge
description:
When performing a charge, increase your move speed by (2.5 x char level) ft.
You are not subject to attacks of opportunity during a Charge attack.

name: Might
description: Grants access to your first class resource, Might.

name: Crushing Blow
description:
Grants access to the following:
Crushing Blow (Bend) - Your next attack increases your RESALL.
Crushing Blow (Break) - Your next attack reduces the target's DODGE.

name: Crushing Blow (Bend)
description: Grants access to Crushing Blow (Bend) - Your next attack increases your RESALL.

name: Crushing Blow (Break)
description: Grants access to Crushing Blow (Break) - Your next attack reduces the target's DODGE.

name: Combat Specialist
description: Choose a Special Combat Action. When that action, add your PRIM to CMAN.

name: Martial Feature II
description: Gain a Martial type Feature of your choice.

name: Weapon Specialization I
description: Choose a weapon you are proficient with. Gain the Weapon Specialization feature for that weapon. If you already have Weapon Specialization for that weapon, select another martial feature to gain instead.

name: Jagged Edges
description: Gain a bonus to TDMG equal to 1/2 your ARMOR.

name: Specialized Combatant
description: Choose a Special Combat Action. When performing that action, gain a bonus equal to char level.

name: Weapon Specialization
description: Choose a weapon you are proficient with. Gain the Weapon Specialization feature for that weapon. If you already have Weapon Specialization for that weapon, select another martial feature to gain instead.

name: Stance
description: Choose an available stance. Gain 1 rank in the chosen stance.

name: Defender (Defense Subclass)
description: Gain a 50% increase to base HP. Gain a bonus to reactions equal to your char level. An adjacent enemy must succeed at a WILL save to attack a target that is not a tank.

name: Fighter (Impairment Subclass)
description: Gain a bonus to DC equal to 1/2 char level. Gain a 50% increase to Debuff. Your impairment effects gain an increase of +1 to duration.

name: Valor
description: Gain access to your first Subclass Resource. Maximum value equal to char level. Restored on long rest.

name: Taunt
description: Gain access to active abilities Taunt and Taunting Shout.

name: Ferocity
description: Gain access to your first Subclass Resource. Maximum value equal to char level. Restored on long rest.

name: Rend
description: Gain access to active abilities Rend and Rending Cleave.

name: Whirlwind
description: Gain access to active ability Whirlwind.

name: Overpower
description: Gain a 50% increase to Critical Damage.

name: Martial Feature III
description: Gain a Martial type Feature of your choice.

name: Slam
description: While equipped with a shield, gain an additional attack for 50% damage. While not using a shield, your first attack each turn gains a +25% modifier.

name: Ignore Pain
description: Gain access to active ability Ignore Pain.

name: Hemorrhage
description: Gain access to active ability Hemorrhage.

name: Rage
description: Gain access to your special Class Resource. Maximum value equal to char level. Decays between combat. Gain 1 Rage at end of your turn if you dealt damage. Gain 1 Rage at start of your turn if you received damage that cycle.

name: Battle Frenzy
description: Gain access to active ability Battle Frenzy.

name: Violent Fury
description: Gain access to active ability Enrage. (Blood rage?)

name: Weapon Expertise
description: Choose a weapon you have specialization for. Gain Weapon Expertise for that weapon. If you already have Weapon Expertise, you may choose another martial feature instead.

name: Parry
description: Gain a bonus to DEF equal to 1/5 of your attack bonus.

name: Hamstring
description: When you apply an impairment to an enemy, apply Hamstring for the same duration. Hamstring reduces movement speed by 50%.

name: Savage Strike
description: Gain access to active ability Savage Strike.

name: Enrage
description: Each time you are dealt damage or deal damage, gain 1 Enrage. Lose 1/2 your enrage stacks at end of round. Your total damage is increased by +1 per Enrage stack.

name: Instigate
description: Gain access to active ability Instigate.

name: Sunder
description: Gain access to active ability Sunder.

name: Raging Blow
description: Gain access to active ability Raging Blow.

name: Intercept
description: Gain access to active ability Intercept.

name: Impale
description: Gain access to active ability Impale.

name: Execution
description: At the resolution of an attack where you dealt damage, any enemy target with more bleed than HP dies.

name: Devastation
description: Your wound effects require two heals to cure.

name: Reckoning
description: Whenever an ally takes damage, you gain +1 TDMG until the end of combat

name: Crusader Seal
description: Activate to begin storing charges. Unleash charges for +0.5 MAXATK per charge until end of turn.

name: Sneak Attack
description:
Usable once per turn.
Target must be unaware, flanked, or exposed.
Increases DMGMULTI by 0.25 and TDMG by (level+1 x level+1)

description: Gain a bonus to saves against hard control effects

name: Unarmed Prowess

You are proficient with unarmed attacks.
Once per turn, gain an advantage over an unaware, flanked, or exposed target.
Increases ATK against that target by (level x level x 0.5)

name: Preparation
description: Grants access to your first class resource, Preparation.

name: Resonant Strike
description:
Grants access to the following:
Grants access to Resonant Strike (Ebb) - Your next attack applies heavy tokens to your target.
Grants access to Resonant Strike (Flow) - Your next attack grants you Shield.

description: Grants access to Resonant Strike (Ebb) - Your next attack applies heavy tokens to your target.

name: Nimble Feet
description:
Negate All Displacement Damage (including fall damage).
Gain a bonus to saves against displacement.
Gain a bonus to MOVE equal to your level.

name: Sharp Senses
description: Gain a bonus to REACT equal to 0.1 x FOC

name: Still Mind
description:
You are immune to mind-based loss of control effects.
You may not speak. You may only attack.

description: Grants access to your subclass resource, Tolerance.

name: Clash
description: Allows you to take an attack for an ally.

name: Tranquility
description: Grants access to your subclass resource, Tranquility.

name: Spear Strike
description: Grants access to Spear Strike, an ability interrupt

name: Fleet Footwork
description: You may use movement abilities between your full-attack actions

name: Sniper's Domain
description:
Increases RANGE by 2.5 x level.
Add TDMG to your attacks based on distance from the enemy.
+[distance in feet] * [character level] / 2.5

name: Favored Enemy and Terrain
description:
Gain + level to ATK and CRIT when fighting favored enemies.
Gain + level to APPLY, SUP, and MAST when fighting in favored terrain.

Your maximum training ranks are increased by 5%.

name: Equipment Evocation
description:
Bonus to max rank of molding techniques.
The first rank of molded weapons does not count against Molding's AL.

name: Fighting Form (Heavy + Light)
description:
Heavy Form: Melee Primary Attribute. Increases ATK and MOVE.
Light Form: Ranged Primary Attribute. Increases APPLY and RANGE.

description: Grants access to your first class resource, Convection.

Grants access to Pulse (Slow) - Your next attack incapacitates the target.

name: Armor Dependency
description:
You are unable to utilize your aura directly.
You are unable to learn aura techniques and require your exo armor to engage in battle.Your armor grants you +1 to all attributes per level.
Your armor grants you + (0.5 * level * level) to ATK and APPLY.
Your armor grants you + (level * level) to BDMG and all SAVES.
Your armor grants you + ( level * level) RESALL and + ( 0.5 * level * level ) to all sub resists.
When armor is unequipped, your MAXHP is reduced by 90%.

name: Patronage
description:
Your gear is prohibitively expensive.
A patron will reduce upgrade costs to the pilot by 90%.
Gain engineering schematics for new tier of Exo Armor at level up.
Your patron may call you to service. If you do not answer the call, you may lose funding.

name: Enhanced Engineering
description:
You receive a free rank of Aura Engineering and its max rank is increased by 1.
Can reverse engineer devices to learn their schematic.
Takes 1 hour per tier to disassemble and reassemble a device.

name: Salvo
description:
You may additionally perform attacks with all equpped weapons as part of a Extended Attack.
These Salvo attacks can each activate a class ability.

name: Charge
description: Grants access to your first class resource, Charge.

description: Grants access to Ionize (Supply) - Your next attack grants an ally RESALL.

name: Ionize (Demand)
